title: SavingFood.ai
subtitle: AI-powered food waste reduction platform
description: A web application that helps food service businesses reduce waste through spoilage prediction, usage tracking, and inventory optimization. Built to address the one-third of all food produced globally that goes to waste.
problem: Roughly one-third of all food produced is wasted globally. In developing countries, the lack of tools to track, predict, and optimize food usage contributes to unnecessary waste while communities face food insecurity. Existing solutions are either enterprise-priced or too generic for small food operators.
role: Built the web application including prediction models for food spoilage, waste tracking dashboards, and the user interface for businesses and community organizations to manage their food waste reduction efforts.
approach: Built with Next.js frontend and Python backend. Prediction models trained on historical spoilage data identify patterns in food waste. Tracking dashboards visualize waste trends over time. Inventory optimization suggests reorder timing based on usage patterns. Clean, accessible interface designed for busy food service operators who need quick insights.
hardestDecision: Making the predictions useful without requiring extensive data input — finding the balance between prediction accuracy and the practical data entry burden on users who are often busy food service operators.
outcome: Live at sf-project-topaz.vercel.app. Provides spoilage prediction, waste tracking, and inventory optimization for food service businesses.
whatIdChange: Would add integration with point-of-sale systems for automatic waste tracking, implement computer vision for food quality assessment, and add community sharing features for surplus food redistribution.
